author: naascott
text:
Hey Lebonardo, just my two cents on CP. These zones can be confusing, and you can spend a lot of time drawing and over-focusing on them. I mean it is quite captivating by how price often slides through them, which in turn can lead to considerable moments of time pondering this component of price. No doubt, cool stuff!

For me, what started to really help me qualify an apparent zone of CP, was what price had done in the past. As CP is part of the approach area, it should be great cause to try and decipher the past along with drawing your zones, too. Of course, it may be quite a bit to digest as you are new. If so, you have my apologies for the confusion.

Here are some good questions to ask

Approach

Reaction

Be well!
